snippet.title: A Game About Digging For Worms — Official Trailer | Steam, December 10
snippet.description:
Dig up your garden, sell worms to an old sailor, upgrade your tools and turn the whole garden into Swiss cheese. The deeper you dig, the stranger it gets — there's a secret down there, and two endings.
